sources.snippet: Overview acestep-v15-xl-turbo is a 4-billion-parameter text-to-audio generation model created by ACE-Step that produces music from text prompts in just 8 inference steps. sources.snippet: This is the XL (4B) SFT variant of ACE-Step 1.5 — a supervised fine-tuned model with ~4B parameters. SFT provides higher audio quality with CFG (Classifier-Free Guidance) support for fine-grained prompt adherence control.
